NetworkEvents.Name: emergencyRestart
NetworkEvents.Description: System is unusable or facing an unrecoverable emergency state.

NetworkEvents.Name: ciscoCpuHighCritical
NetworkEvents.Description: CPU utilization has reached critical threshold levels.

NetworkEvents.Name: linkDown
NetworkEvents.Description: A communication link has fallen (Critical interface down event).

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfConfigError
NetworkEvents.Description: A packet has been received on a non-virtual interface with conflicting configuration parameters.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfAuthFailure
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies an authentication key or type failure on an OSPF interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: authenticationFailure
NetworkEvents.Description: The SNMP entity has received a protocol message that is not properly authenticated.

NetworkEvents.Name: DuplexMismatch
NetworkEvents.Description: A duplex mismatch discovered on a network interface (half vs full duplex conflict).

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfStateChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Change in the state of an OSPF virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfStateChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Change in the state of a non-virtual OSPF interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ciscoSyslogMessageGenerated
NetworkEvents.Description: A Cisco proprietary trap generated when a new Syslog message is logged.

NetworkEvents.Name: coldStart
NetworkEvents.Description: The SNMP entity is reinitializing itself and configuration may have changed.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfLsdbOverflow
NetworkEvents.Description: Number of LSAs in the link state database has exceeded the limit.

NetworkEvents.Name: warmStart
NetworkEvents.Description: The SNMP entity is reinitializing itself with unaltered configuration.

NetworkEvents.Name: linkUp
NetworkEvents.Description: A communication link has come up (Interface restored).

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfOriginateLsa
NetworkEvents.Description: A new LSA has been originated by this router.

NetworkEvents.Name: envMonPollNotice
NetworkEvents.Description: Environmental monitor notification or general informational notice.

NetworkEvents.Name: snmpDebugPacketTrace
NetworkEvents.Description: Detailed packet trace or debug level information for troubleshooting.
